text:
leo-sales: Heads-up  NovaHealth asked for a short POC (4 weeks). They want recommended reserved GPU commit, autoscale policy, and what we can promise for steady vs burst latency. Workload: chat completions + vector similarity. Steady ~240 rps, spikes to ~1.3k rps for 7-15min, avg payload ~130 tokens. They need VPC peering, SOC2 artifacts, and are asking about customer-managed KMS for test. Any red flags?

jill-solutions: Good lead. Two quick Qs: are spikes geo-localized or global? and what's expected concurrent sessions during peak? those affect warmup and AZ spread.

leo-sales: Spikes are primarily US-East. Concurrent sessions ~2.5k at peak. They want 99.9% uptime during biz hours.

marc-runtime: Sizing note: with our q4 profile we hit ~320 rps per GPU for this shape on A100-equivalent. For steady 240 rps you could run on 1 GPU if tolerating no headroom, but realistic POC sizing: 6 reserved GPUs as baseline (to meet SLA headroom + KV cache saturation across AZs) and autoscale up to 18 GPUs for burst. Locking model+quant is important for predictability (e.g., clarity-v2 + q4_0).

anya-sre: Operational recommendations: AZ spread (2 per AZ minimum), warm KV prefill, and a circuit-breaker to degrade to a smaller model when queue_depth gets high. We use this presales template: 

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: "2"
  reserved_replicas: "6"   # committed pool for POC
  max_replicas: "18"
  target_rps_per_gpu: "320"
  scale_window: "60s"
  preheat_window: "6m"   # pre-warm KV cache
  cooldown: "90s"
  az_spread: "true"
  circuit_breaker:
    queue_depth: ">400"
    action: "route_to_small_model"
```

jill-solutions: For the POC we recommend 6 reserved + 12 burstable, a capped burst-credit pool (e.g., 10k burst-minutes) and a mandatory 48-72hr smoke run mid-POC using the customer's golden prompts to validate tail latency and cost. We'll supply the runbook and the load script.

noah-pricing: Pricing impact: 6 reserved GPUs baseline, burst billed at on-demand. For the capped credit pool I can add a single-line SKU. If they want a premium latency SLA we need to increase reserved commit (estimate 2x) and add a premium SLA surcharge; will prepare two quote scenarios. Need an estimate of average burst minutes per week to finalize numbers.

rita-security: SOC2 docs ok to share. For CMK: enabling customer-managed keys in a Dedicated environment is an enterprise feature with setup lead time. For the POC we can offer sanitized audit logs and an option to store logs encrypted with our KMS; CMK requires a security review and additional contract terms. Also we need their IP ranges for VPC peering.

leo-sales: Legal asked if we can commit to 50ms 50p gen latency for chat during steady-state. Feasible?

marc-runtime: At ~130 tokens and this model, 50ms 50p is unrealistic. Reasonable POC targets: embeddings/search 50p <100ms (with caching and reserved commit), chat 50p <250ms during steady if preheated and pinned. If they truly need 50ms, offer a premium path: distilled model + higher commit + priority routing.

anya-sre: Ops checklist to call out in proposal:
- customer IP allowlist for VPC peering
- acceptance of cross-AZ preheat traffic
- golden-prompt set + acceptance criteria for tail latency
- smoke-run schedule (48-72hr) mid-POC
- alerting for queue-depth, GPU saturation, and 95p latency breaches

jill-solutions: Also include explicit model pin in the contract and a fallback policy (auto-route to smaller model or degrade non-critical routes) to keep availability during overload.

ops-bot: presales-smokejob queued: novahealth_poc_2026-09-10, ETA 15m.

noah-pricing: Suggested next steps: 1) Ill draft two pricing options (standard POC + premium-latency), 2) Rita will attach SOC2 + CMK timeline note, 3) Anya will stage sandbox reserved pool and post test commands, 4) Jill will prepare the runbook and golden-prompt list.

leo-sales: Ill ask NovaHealth for CIDRs and expected burst cadence; will also confirm whether they want CMK during the POC or only in GA. Thanks team  tagging @jill-solutions @anya-sre @noah-pricing @rita-security

jill-solutions: Ill start the runbook draft and include the warmup script (/tools/presales/warmup.sh) and rollback steps.

rita-security: Ill post the SOC2 bundle and a short checklist they can return with the questionnaire (CIDRs, retention, CMK intent).

anya-sre: Ill stage the sandbox pool and post the smoke run profile soon.

leo-sales: Closing loop for now  will update customer once we have CIDRs and pricing. :thumbsup:
